summary: The school district emphasizes the importance of preserving and strengthening the E-Rate program to ensure reliable broadband connectivity for modern public education. The school district and advocacy group argue against limiting or sunsetting E-Rate funding, emphasizing the importance of reliable broadband connectivity for education and the potential financial burden on districts. The school district opposes sunsetting E-Rate and urges the Commission to preserve and strengthen the program to ensure all students have access to reliable, affordable broadband for educational purposes.
